title.zh: 卷342 列傳一百二十九 保寧 松筠子：熙昌 富俊 窦心傳 博启图
title.en: Volume 342 Biographies 129: Bao Ning, Song Yun son: Xi Chang, Fu Jun, Dou Xinchuan, Bo Qi Tu
title.raw: 卷342 列傳一百二十九 保寧 松筠子：熙昌 富俊 窦心傳 博启图

sentences.zh: 保寧，圖伯特氏，蒙古正白旗人，靖逆將軍納穆札勒子。

translations.literal: Bao Ning, of the Tubote clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, was the son of Pacification General Namuzhale.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning belonged to the Tubote clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, and was the son of Pacification General Namuzhale.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，納穆札勒殉節回疆，錫封三等公。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, Namuzhale died defending his post in the Western Regions and was posthumously enfeoffed as a third-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong era, Namuzhale gave his life defending the frontier in the Western Regions and was posthumously granted the title of third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 保寧由親軍襲爵，授乾清門侍衛。

translations.literal: Bao Ning inherited the title through the Imperial Guard corps and was appointed a gate guard of the Qianqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning succeeded to his father's rank through service in the Imperial Guard and was made a gate guard of the Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，力戰，迭克要隘，​​將軍阿桂薦其才，擢陝西興漢鎮總兵。

translations.literal: On campaign in Jinchuan he fought fiercely, repeatedly capturing strategic passes; General Agui recommended his ability, and he was promoted to regional commander of Xinghan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jinchuan campaign he fought fiercely and took one critical pass after another; General Agui commended his talent, and he was promoted to regional commander at Xinghan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 金川平，繪像紫光閣，御製贊，褒其膽勇持重，少年如宿將。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Glory with an imperial inscription praising his courage, steadiness, and veteran bearing despite his youth.
translations.idiomatic: After the pacification of Jinchuan, his portrait was hung in the Hall of Purple Glory with an imperial ode praising his bold and steady command—though still young, he had the bearing of a seasoned general.

sentences.zh: 尋調河南南陽鎮、直隸馬蘭鎮，兼總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to the Nanyang garrison in Henan and the Malan garrison in Zhili, and concurrently served as superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to commands at Nanyang in Henan and Malan in Zhili, and at the same time made superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 擢江南提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，授成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year [of Qianlong], he was appointed General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong he was appointed commanding general at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 甘肅石峰堡回叛，命選屯練番兵赴鞏昌、安定助剿，平之。

translations.literal: When Muslims at Shifeng Fort in Gansu rebelled, he was ordered to select trained garrison troops and native soldiers to aid the suppression at Gongchang and Anding; the rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muslim uprising broke out at Shifeng Fort in Gansu, he was ordered to send selected garrison and native troops to Gongchang and Anding to assist in the campaign, and the rebellion was put down.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，授四川總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, he was appointed Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year he was made governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 保寧謹慎有操守，盡心邊事。

translations.literal: Bao Ning was cautious and of principled conduct, devoting himself wholeheartedly to frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning was scrupulous and upright in character, and threw himself wholeheartedly into frontier administration.

sentences.zh: 邊夷上下孟董、九子等寨生齒日繁，請增設營員，以屯練有勞績者拔補；

translations.literal: As the frontier tribes of the upper and lower Mengdong and Jiuzi stockades grew in population, he requested additional garrison officers, to be filled by promoting men of merit among the trained colonists;
translations.idiomatic: As the frontier peoples of the upper and lower Mengdong and Jiuzi stockades multiplied, he asked that new garrison officers be added and filled by promoting colonists who had distinguished themselves in service;

sentences.zh: 改修打箭爐城，扼要築卡，駐兵捍衛；

translations.literal: he had Dajianlu city rebuilt, erected barrier posts at strategic points, and stationed troops to guard them;
translations.idiomatic: he had Dajianlu city repaired, built barrier posts at key points, and stationed troops to hold them;

sentences.zh: 改黃梁、大定、白雞、白鹿等八寨熟苗編入民戶：並協機宜。

translations.literal: and he enrolled the acculturated Miao of the eight stockades of Huangliang, Dading, Baiji, Bailu, and others among the civil population—all measures well suited to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: and he registered the acculturated Miao of the eight stockades at Huangliang, Dading, Baiji, Bailu, and elsewhere as ordinary households—all measures judged timely and appropriate.

sentences.zh: 次年，調伊犁將軍，兼內大臣，籌備倉儲。

translations.literal: The following year he was transferred to be General of Ili, concurrently an inner court minister, to organize grain reserves.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to the post of general at Ili, made an inner court minister as well, and charged with building up the granaries.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「伊犁一年支糧十六萬六千餘石，不敷二萬三千石，歷就舊儲五十餘萬石內填補。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Ili requires more than 166,000 piculs of grain annually yet falls short by 23,000 piculs, which has been made up from older reserves of more than 500,000 piculs.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he reported: "Ili's yearly grain expenditure exceeds 166,000 piculs, with a shortfall of some 23,000 piculs that has been covered year after year from older stores of over 500,000 piculs.

sentences.zh: 現賸三十餘萬石，雖尚可敷十餘年之用，地處極邊，若不補籌餘糧，偶遇歉收，或有需糧之事，慮難接濟。

translations.literal: At present only 300,000-odd piculs remain; although this could last more than ten years, the region lies at the utter frontier—if surplus grain is not laid in and there is a poor harvest or sudden demand, relief may be hard to supply.
translations.idiomatic: Only about 300,000 piculs remain on hand—enough for a dozen years at current use, perhaps, but Ili lies at the empire's far edge; without rebuilding the surplus, a lean year or an emergency could leave us unable to provide in time.

sentences.zh: 請撥兵丁七百名，增開七屯，自來年耕種，歲可收糧一萬九千餘石，永遠備貯。

translations.literal: He requested 700 soldier-cultivators to open seven new military farms; planting would begin the next year, yielding more than 19,000 piculs annually for permanent reserve.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that seven hundred troops be assigned to open seven new colonies, with planting beginning the following year; the yearly yield would exceed 19,000 piculs for a standing reserve.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " His proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 又奏添設惠遠城鳥槍步甲四百名。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to add four hundred musket infantry at Huining city.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that four hundred musket infantry be added to the garrison at Huining city.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，入覲，途次命赴四川暫署總督事。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, while proceeding to court for an audience, he was ordered en route to go to Sichuan and temporarily act as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, on his way to the capital for an audience, he was ordered to proceed to Sichuan and serve temporarily as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 次年，回任，加太子少保，授御前大臣。

translations.literal: The following year he returned to his post, was given the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and appointed an imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he resumed his post, was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and appointed an imperial presence minister.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城創立三十餘年，戶口日繁，於城東展築，擴舊城四分之一。

translations.literal: Huining city had been founded more than thirty years; as the population grew daily, he extended construction east of the city, enlarging the old city by one quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Huining city was more than thirty years old and its population was growing steadily; he extended the walls on the east side, adding a quarter to the area of the old city.

sentences.zh: 伊犁無通曉俄羅斯語言者，請於京師俄館選派一人來教習官兵子弟，五年期滿，試最優者充筆帖式。

translations.literal: As no one at Ili understood Russian, he requested that one person be selected from the Russian lodge in the capital to instruct officers' and soldiers' sons; after five years the best in examination would be appointed a clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Because no one at Ili knew Russian, he asked that a teacher be sent from the Russian lodge in the capital to instruct the sons of officers and soldiers; after five years the top examinee would be appointed a clerk.

sentences.zh: 俄屬烏梁海潛往哈屯河外汗山地方游牧，帝慮其滋事，命保寧察視，疏言：「烏梁海居住甚安戢，不必驅逐，飭邊卡防範，無庸添兵。

translations.literal: Uriankhai subjects of Russia had secretly gone to pasture beyond the Hatun River at Mount Han; the emperor feared trouble and ordered Bao Ning to investigate. He memorialized: "The Uriankhai are living in great peace; there is no need to drive them out—only tighten border post vigilance; no additional troops are required.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai under Russian rule had quietly moved to graze beyond the Hatun River at Mount Han; the emperor feared they might cause trouble and sent Bao Ning to look into the matter. He reported: "The Uriankhai are living quite peacefully and need not be expelled—only the border posts need to be kept alert; there is no need to add troops.

sentences.zh: 」察哈爾兵丁及土爾扈特私竊哈薩克馬匹，緝獲，置之法。

translations.literal: " Chahar soldiers and Torghut tribesmen who had privately stolen Kazakh horses were seized and punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: " Chahar soldiers and Torghuts who had stolen Kazakh horses on their own were caught and punished by law.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉保寧無偏袒，得外籓心，予議敘。

translations.literal: The emperor commended Bao Ning for showing no partiality and winning the hearts of the outer tribes, and granted him consideration for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Bao Ning for acting without favoritism and winning the loyalty of the frontier peoples, and ordered that his service be considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 六十年，召授吏部尚書，兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統，甫數月，復出為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Personnel, concurrently commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army; after only a few months he was again sent out as General of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was recalled to the capital as Minister of Personnel and commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army; after only a few months he was sent out again as general at Ili.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，協辦大學士，尋拜武英殿大學士，加太子太保，任邊事如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was made Associate Grand Secretary, soon after Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory, with the honorary title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, continuing to manage frontier affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he became Associate Grand Secretary, then Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory, with the title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, while continuing to handle frontier affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特家奴三吉污主母孀婦伯克木庫殞命，特詔予伯克木庫旌表。

translations.literal: A Torghut household slave named Sanji defiled his mistress, the widow Berkemuku, who died; an especial edict granted Berkemuku posthumous commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut bondservant Sanji violated his mistress, the widow Berkemuku, who died as a result; the throne issued a special edict honoring Berkemuku with official commendation.

sentences.zh: 保寧疏陳駐防孀婦守節，未舉旌表之典，請照內地一體辦理。

translations.literal: Bao Ning memorialized that widows among the garrison who preserved chastity had not been given the usual commendation and requested that they be treated the same as in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning reported that widows among the frontier garrisons who kept their chastity had not received the usual imperial commendation, and asked that they be honored by the same rules as in the interior provinces.

sentences.zh: 於是採訪各城，請旌者凡七十人，後著為令。

translations.literal: Thereupon inquiries were made in every city and seventy persons were nominated for commendation; this was later made a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiries were then made in every garrison city, and seventy women were nominated for honors; the practice was later codified as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 七年，召還京，授領侍衛內大臣，管理兵部，兼管三庫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital, appointed Chief Guard of the Inner Palace, placed in charge of the Board of War, and concurrently superintendent of the three treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital, made Chief Guard of the Inner Palace, put in charge of the Board of War, and given concurrent control of the three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 八年，因孝淑皇后山陵典禮會疏措詞不經，褫銜鐫級留任。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because a joint memorial on the empress dowager Xiaoshu's tomb rites used improper wording, his titles were stripped and his rank reduced by one degree, but he was retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, a joint memorial on the tomb rites for Empress Xiaoshu used language deemed improper; his honors were stripped and his rank reduced by one degree, but he was kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 保寧兩鎮伊犁，歷十餘年，西陲無事，籓部悅服。

translations.literal: Bao Ning twice held command at Ili for more than ten years in all; the western frontier was untroubled and the tributary tribes were content.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning commanded at Ili on two occasions for more than ten years in all; the western frontier remained peaceful and the frontier peoples were well disposed toward the court.

sentences.zh: 既去任，朝廷遇邊疆興革，每諮決焉。

translations.literal: After he left office, whenever the court faced frontier innovations or reforms, it regularly sought his judgment.
translations.idiomatic: After he left office, the court regularly consulted him whenever frontier policy required new measures or reforms.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以疾乞休，命在家食公爵全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, citing illness, he requested retirement and was ordered to receive the full salary of a duke while at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he asked to retire on grounds of illness and was permitted to remain at home on the full stipend of a duke.

sentences.zh: 逾兩年，卒，賜金優恤，諡文端，祠祀伊犁。

translations.literal: More than two years later he died; gold was granted for generous condolence, his posthumous title was Wenduan, and a shrine was established for him at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than two years later he died; the court granted gold for a generous funeral and gave him the posthumous name Wenduan, with a shrine established in his honor at Ili.

sentences.zh: 子慶祥嗣爵，殉回疆之難，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Qingxiang succeeded to the title and died a martyr in the troubles in the Western Regions; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qingxiang inherited the title and gave his life in the Western Regions crisis; he has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 次子慶惠，由廕生授侍衛，歷官侍郎，三以罪黜復起。

translations.literal: His second son Qinghui, through hereditary privilege appointed a guard, rose to vice-president, and was dismissed for crime three times yet restored each time.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Qinghui entered service by hereditary privilege as a guard, rose to vice-president, and was dismissed for misconduct three times only to be reappointed each time.

sentences.zh: 道光中，官至熱河都統，以疾歸，卒，諡勤僖。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang reign he reached the post of commander at Rehe, returned home on account of illness, died, and received the posthumous title Qinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Under Daoguang he rose to commander at Rehe, retired home because of illness, and died; his posthumous name was Qinxi.

sentences.zh: 松筠，字湘浦，瑪拉特氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Song Yun, style Xiangpu, of the Marat clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun, whose style was Xiangpu, belonged to the Marat clan and was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 繙譯生員，考授理籓院筆帖式，充軍機章京，能任事，為高宗所知。

translations.literal: A translation licentiate, he passed examination and was appointed a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs, served as a Grand Council secretary, proved capable in office, and came to the notice of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Having qualified as a translation licentiate, he passed the examination for a clerkship in the Court of Colonial Affairs, served on the Grand Council staff, showed himself capable in office, and won the notice of the Qianlong emperor.

sentences.zh: 累遷銀庫員外郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to vice-director of the silver treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in stages to vice-director of the silver treasury.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，超擢內閣學士，兼副都統。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong he was promoted by special selection to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, concurrently vice commander of the Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong he was singled out for rapid promotion to grand secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and made vice commander of a Banner as well.

sentences.zh: 五十年，命往庫倫治俄羅斯貿易事。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was ordered to Khuree to manage Russian trade affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he was sent to Khuree to handle trade with Russia.

sentences.zh: 先是，俄屬布哩雅特人劫掠庫倫商貨，俄官不依例交犯，僅罰償，流之遠地，檄問未聽命，詔停恰克圖貿易。

translations.literal: Earlier, Buryats under Russia had plundered merchants' goods at Khuree; the Russian officials did not hand over the culprits as required but only imposed fines and banished them to distant places; repeated demands by dispatch went unanswered, and trade at Kyakhta was ordered suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Buryats subject to Russia had robbed Khuree merchants; Russian officials refused to surrender the offenders as required, imposing only fines and banishing them to distant regions; repeated official demands went unanswered, and the throne ordered trade at Kyakhta suspended.

sentences.zh: 松筠至，尋充辦事大臣。

translations.literal: When Song Yun arrived, he soon served as resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: When Song Yun arrived, he was soon appointed resident minister at Khuree.

sentences.zh: 閉關後，邊禁嚴而不擾，遇俄人皆開誠待之。

translations.literal: After the border was closed, frontier restrictions were strict yet not oppressive; whenever he met Russians he treated them with open sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: After the border was closed, frontier controls were strict but not harassing; in every encounter with Russians he dealt with them openly and in good faith.

sentences.zh: 擢戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯以貿易久停，有悔意，撤舊官，屢請開市，未許。

translations.literal: Russia, because trade had long been suspended, showed repentance, removed the old officials, and repeatedly requested reopening the market, but permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: With trade long suspended, Russia showed regret, replaced the old officials, and repeatedly asked to reopen the market, but permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 卡倫兵出巡，復為布哩雅特人所殺。

translations.literal: Border-post soldiers on patrol were again killed by Buryats.
translations.idiomatic: Border-post soldiers on patrol were again killed by Buryats.

sentences.zh: 松筠曰：「舊事未了，又生旁支，然亦了事之機也。

translations.literal: Song Yun said: "The old affair is unsettled and a new branch has arisen, yet this may also be the moment to settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun said: "The old case is still open and a new incident has arisen, yet this may also be the chance to bring everything to a close.

sentences.zh: 」檄俄官縛送三人，親訊於界上，斬其二，流其一，請兩案並結。

translations.literal: " He dispatched a note demanding the Russian officials send bound three men; he personally examined them at the border, executed two, banished one, and requested that both cases be closed together.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent a dispatch demanding that Russian officials deliver three men bound; he personally tried them at the border, executed two, banished one, and asked that both cases be settled together.

sentences.zh: 詔斥專擅，褫職，仍留庫倫效力。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for acting on his own authority, stripped him of office, yet left him at Khuree to continue serving.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked him for overstepping his authority, removed him from office, but kept him at Khuree to continue serving.

sentences.zh: 會西路土爾扈特喇嘛薩邁林者，迷路入哈薩克，歸攜書信，訛言俄人誘致土爾扈特謀亂，下松筠察狀。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Torghut lama Samailin of the western route, having lost his way into Kazakh territory, returned carrying letters falsely alleging that Russians had induced the Torghuts to plot rebellion; Song Yun was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: About this time the Torghut lama Samailin of the western route, having strayed into Kazakh territory, came back with letters falsely claiming that Russians had incited the Torghuts to rebel; Song Yun was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 疏言俄羅斯實恭順，無可疑。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Russia was in fact deferential and gave no cause for suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial he reported that Russia was in fact deferential and gave no grounds for suspicion.

sentences.zh: 俄人亦自陳證薩邁林書信出偽造。

translations.literal: The Russians also declared on their own account that Samailin's letters were forged.
translations.idiomatic: The Russians themselves stated that Samailin's letters were forgeries.

sentences.zh: 詔置薩邁林於法，許復開市。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Samailin punished by law and permitted trade to reopen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Samailin punished according to law and allowed trade to reopen.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，召俄官會議定約，親蒞俄帳宴飲，諭以恩信，大悅服。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he summoned Russian officials to negotiate and fix a treaty, personally attended their tent for a feast, instructed them in grace and good faith, and they were greatly pleased and submissive.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he summoned Russian officials to negotiate a treaty, personally attended a feast in their camp, spoke to them of imperial grace and trust, and they were deeply impressed and won over.

sentences.zh: 事曆八年然後定。

translations.literal: The affair took eight years before it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years passed before the matter was finally settled.

sentences.zh: 召還京，授御前侍衛、內務府大臣、軍機大臣。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital and appointed imperial bodyguard, Minister of the Imperial Household, and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the capital and made imperial bodyguard, minister of the Imperial Household, and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 命護送英吉利貢使回廣東，凡所要索皆嚴拒。

translations.literal: He was ordered to escort the English tribute embassy back to Guangdong; every demand they made was firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to escort the English tribute embassy back to Guangdong and firmly refused every demand they made.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，署吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he acted as General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he served as acting general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 尋命往荊州察稅務，道出衛輝，大水環城，率守令開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to Jingzhou to inspect tax affairs; passing Weihui, great floods surrounded the city, and he led the magistrates to open the granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to Jingzhou to inspect tax affairs; on the road at Weihui, floods had surrounded the city, and he led the local officials to open the granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉獎，授工部尚書兼都統。

translations.literal: An edict commended him and appointed him Minister of Works, concurrently banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: The throne commended him by edict and appointed him Minister of Works with concurrent command of a Banner.

sentences.zh: 充駐藏大臣，撫番多惠政。

translations.literal: He served as Resident Minister in Tibet and in pacifying the Tibetans enacted many benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: As resident minister in Tibet he governed the Tibetans with many measures of real benefit.

sentences.zh: 和珅用事，松筠不為屈，遂久留邊地。

translations.literal: When Heshen held power, Song Yun would not yield to him and was therefore kept long on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: While Heshen dominated the court, Song Yun refused to bend to him and was kept on the frontier for many years.

sentences.zh: 在藏凡五年。

translations.literal: He was in Tibet altogether five years.
translations.idiomatic: He spent five years in all in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年春，召為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiaqing he was summoned as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiaqing he was recalled as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋授陝甘總督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, with the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu and given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 時教匪張漢潮及藍號、白號諸黨擾陝、甘。

translations.literal: At the time the sect rebel Zhang Hanchao and the Blue Banner, White Banner, and other factions were harassing Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the sect rebel Zhang Hanchao and the Blue Banner, White Banner, and other rebel bands were ravaging Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 松筠至，駐漢中，治糧餉給諸軍。

translations.literal: When Song Yun arrived, he stationed himself at Hanzhong and managed grain and pay for the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Song Yun arrived he took post at Hanzhong and organized grain and supplies for the armies.

sentences.zh: 自軍興，給陝西餉銀一千一百萬兩，至是續撥一百五十萬，設局清釐，按旬諮部。

translations.literal: Since the campaign began, 11,000,000 taels of pay had been allotted to Shaanxi; at this time a further 1,500,000 was allocated, an office was established for clearing accounts, and reports were sent to the ministry every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began, eleven million taels of military pay had been sent to Shaanxi; he now secured another 1.5 million, set up an office to audit accounts, and reported to the ministry every ten days.

sentences.zh: 命陳諸將優劣，密疏言：「明亮知兵而罔實效；

translations.literal: He was ordered to report on the merits and faults of the generals and submitted a secret memorial stating: "Mingliang understands warfare but achieves no real results;
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to assess the commanders, he submitted a secret memorial: "Mingliang knows warfare but produces no real results;

sentences.zh: 恆瑞前戰湖北功最，年近六旬，精力大減；

translations.literal: Heng Rui's earlier service in Hubei won the greatest merit, but he is nearly sixty and his vigor has greatly declined;
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui earned the greatest credit in the earlier fighting in Hubei, but he is nearly sixty and his strength has greatly declined;

sentences.zh: 慶成有勇無謀；

translations.literal: Qingcheng has courage but no strategy;
translations.idiomatic: Qingcheng is brave but lacks strategy;

sentences.zh: 永保無謀無勇，不能治兵，並不能治民；

translations.literal: Yongbao has neither strategy nor courage, cannot command troops, and cannot govern the people either;
translations.idiomatic: Yongbao has neither strategy nor courage; he cannot command troops and cannot govern the people either;

sentences.zh: 惟額勒登保、德楞泰能辦賊。

translations.literal: only Erlibao and Delengtai can deal with the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: only Erlibao and Delengtai are capable of dealing with the rebels.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗深嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The Jiaqing emperor greatly approved and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: " The Jiaqing emperor was deeply pleased and accepted his judgment.

sentences.zh: 明亮劾永保、慶成避賊，下松筠逮治。

translations.literal: Mingliang impeached Yongbao and Qingcheng for evading the bandits; Song Yun was ordered to arrest and try them.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang impeached Yongbao and Qingcheng for shirking the rebels; Song Yun was ordered to arrest and try them.

sentences.zh: 永保亦與荊州將軍興肇訐明亮誑報軍功，詔並褫職，遣尚書那彥成赴陝會鞫。

translations.literal: Yongbao also joined with Jingzhou General Xingzhao to accuse Mingliang of falsely reporting military merit; an edict stripped all of them of office and sent Minister Nayancheng to Shaanxi to conduct a joint trial.
translations.idiomatic: Yongbao also joined Jingzhou General Xingzhao in accusing Mingliang of falsifying battle reports; an edict stripped them all of office and sent Minister Nayancheng to Shaanxi for a joint investigation.

sentences.zh: 會明亮已擊斃張漢潮，松筠請緩其獄，又請留撒拉爾回兵，令慶成率以協剿，帝不允。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Mingliang had already killed Zhang Hanchao in battle; Song Yun requested that his case be eased, and also asked to retain the Salar Muslim troops under Qingcheng for joint suppression—the emperor did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: By then Mingliang had already killed Zhang Hanchao in battle; Song Yun asked that his trial be eased and also requested that Salar Muslim troops be kept under Qingcheng for joint operations—the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 既而那彥成劾忄互瑞棄藍號垂盡之賊，折回陝西，由松筠所誤。

translations.literal: Thereupon Nayancheng impeached Heng Rui for abandoning bandits of the Blue Banner faction on the verge of destruction and returning to Shaanxi—an error attributable to Song Yun.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng then impeached Heng Rui for letting the nearly annihilated Blue Banner rebels slip away and marching back into Shaanxi, blaming Song Yun for the mistake.

sentences.zh: 詔褫松筠宮銜、侍衛，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Song Yun of his court titles and guard appointment but left him in the post of governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Song Yun of his court honors and guard appointment but kept him as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 川匪犯南鄭，復分犯西鄉、沔縣、略陽。

translations.literal: Sichuan bandits attacked Nanzheng and again divided forces to raid Xixiang, Mianxian, and Lueyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan rebels attacked Nanzheng and sent detachments against Xixiang, Mianxian, and Lueyang.

sentences.zh: 松筠素謂匪多脅從，可諭降，欲單騎赴之。

translations.literal: Song Yun had long held that most bandits were coerced followers who could be persuaded to surrender, and he wished to go alone on horseback to them.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun had long maintained that most rebels were coerced followers who could be talked into surrendering, and he wanted to ride out alone to meet them.

sentences.zh: 副將韓嘉業固諫曰：「諭之不從而喪總督，大損國威，為天下笑。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Han Jiaye firmly remonstrated: "If persuasion fails and the governor-general is lost, national prestige will suffer greatly and the empire will be laughed at.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Han Jiaye urged him strongly: "If they refuse to listen and the governor-general is killed, the nation's prestige will suffer greatly and the court will be mocked throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 請先往。

translations.literal: Please let me go first.
translations.idiomatic: Let me go first.

sentences.zh: 」嘉業果被害。

translations.literal: " Jiaye was indeed killed.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiaye was indeed killed.

sentences.zh: 賊竄徽縣、兩當。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Huixian and Liangdang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into Huixian and Liangdang.

sentences.zh: 五年春，額勒登保、那彥成會剿，乃分路遁。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, Erlibao and Nayancheng joined in suppression and the rebels dispersed along separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, Erlibao and Nayancheng combined forces against them, and the rebels broke up and fled along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 於是命長麟代為陝甘總督，授松筠伊犁將軍，未之任，暫署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Thereupon Changlin was ordered to replace him as Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu; Song Yun was appointed General of Ili but did not take up the post and temporarily acted as Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Changlin was then appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu in his place; Song Yun was named general at Ili but did not take up the post and served temporarily as acting governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 自請入覲面陳軍事，先在陝上疏言：「賊不患不平，而患在將平之時。

translations.literal: He requested an audience to report on military affairs in person, and first memorialized from Shaanxi: "The bandits are not hard to pacify; the difficulty lies in the moment when pacification is near.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to go to court in person to report on military affairs, and first memorialized from Shaanxi: "The rebels are not hard to suppress; the danger comes when suppression is nearly complete.

sentences.zh: 既平之後，請弛私鹽、私鑄之禁，俾餘匪散勇有所謀生。

translations.literal: After pacification, I request that prohibitions on private salt and private coining be relaxed so that remaining bandits and discharged braves may have means to live.
translations.idiomatic: After peace is restored, I ask that bans on illicit salt and coining be eased so that remaining rebels and discharged soldiers can find honest livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 」帝以其言迂闊，置之。

translations.literal: " The emperor regarded his words as impractical and broad and set them aside.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor considered his proposal impractical and ignored it.

sentences.zh: 至京，復以為請，忤旨，降副都統銜，充伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On reaching the capital he again made the same request, offended the throne, was reduced to vice banner commander rank, and appointed brigade commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the capital he pressed the same request again, displeased the emperor, was demoted to vice banner commander, and sent as brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to general at Ili.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中屢詔伊犁屯田，皆以灌溉乏水未大興，松筠力任其事，預計安插官兵。

translations.literal: During Qianlong edicts had repeatedly ordered military colonization at Ili, but for lack of irrigation water it had not been greatly developed; Song Yun took the task on vigorously and planned in advance for settling officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the court had repeatedly ordered military farming at Ili, but lack of irrigation water had kept it from flourishing; Song Yun threw himself into the work and planned ahead for settling officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城需八萬畝，惠寧城需四萬畝，乃於伊犁河北引水開渠，逶迤數十里，又於城西北導水泉。

translations.literal: Huining city required 80,000 mu and Huining's companion city 40,000 mu; he therefore diverted water north of the Ili River to open canals winding for several tens of li, and also channeled springs northwest of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Huining city needed eighty thousand mu and Huining's companion settlement forty thousand; he diverted water from north of the Ili River into canals winding for dozens of li, and also brought spring water in from the northwest of the city.

sentences.zh: 凡兩城有水之地皆開渠，授田為世業，給穀種、田器、馬牛。

translations.literal: Wherever both cities had water, canals were opened, fields were granted as hereditary holdings, and grain seed, farm tools, horses, and cattle were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the two cities had water, he opened canals, granted fields as hereditary holdings, and supplied seed grain, farm tools, horses, and cattle.

sentences.zh: 然旗人多驕逸，或殺食所給牛，鬻田器棄不耕，反覆曉諭始聽命。

translations.literal: Yet many bannermen were proud and indolent; some slaughtered and ate the cattle given them, sold their farm tools and abandoned cultivation—only after repeated instruction did they obey.
translations.idiomatic: But many bannermen were proud and idle; some slaughtered the cattle they were given, sold their tools and left the land untilled—only after repeated persuasion did they comply.

sentences.zh: 比去任，凡墾田六萬四千畝。

translations.literal: By the time he left office, 64,000 mu of land had been brought under cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he left office, sixty-four thousand mu of land had been opened for farming.

sentences.zh: 寧遠叛兵蒲大芳等譴戍塔爾巴哈台，其黨馬友元等分戍南路諸城。

translations.literal: The Ningyuan mutineers Pu Dafang and others were banished to garrison Tarbagatai, while their followers Ma Youyuan and others were dispersed to garrison various cities on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: The Ningyuan mutineers Pu Dafang and others were exiled to Tarbagatai, while followers such as Ma Youyuan were sent to garrison cities along the southern route.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，大芳复謀逆，捕其黨五十餘人誅之。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year Dafang again plotted rebellion; more than fifty of his followers were seized and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year Dafang plotted rebellion again; more than fifty of his followers were captured and put to death.

sentences.zh: 次年，檄調馬友元等百餘人赴伊犁種地，悉斬於途。

translations.literal: The next year he summoned by dispatch more than a hundred men including Ma Youyuan to Ili for farming; all were executed on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he ordered more than a hundred men including Ma Youyuan to Ili to farm; all were executed en route.

sentences.zh: 詔斥未鞫而殺，失政體，降喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for killing without trial, violating proper governance, and demoted him to Kashgar Assistant Resident.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked him for executing men without trial, a breach of proper governance, and demoted him to assistant resident at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 复授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 調兩江總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 南河自馬港口墊陷，黃水倒漾，淤運阻漕。

translations.literal: On the southern canal, since the siltation at Magangkou, the Yellow River water had backed up, silting the transport channel and obstructing the grain tribute route.
translations.idiomatic: On the southern canal, siltation at Magangkou had caused the Yellow River to back up, choking the transport channel and blocking the grain tribute route.

sentences.zh: 偕河督吳璥察勘海口，請復故道。

translations.literal: Together with Grand Canal Director Wu Jin he inspected the estuary and requested restoration of the old channel.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Grand Canal Director Wu Jin he surveyed the estuary and asked that the old channel be restored.

sentences.zh: 制疏沙器具，試之河口果驗；

translations.literal: He devised sand-dredging implements, tested them at the river mouth with success;
translations.idiomatic: He devised sand-dredging tools, tested them at the river mouth with success;

sentences.zh: 又造撥船千艘，改小運船，親駐河干督趲，渡黃回空皆迅速。

translations.literal: also built a thousand lighter boats and converted small transport vessels; he personally stationed himself on the riverbank to supervise urgency, and crossing the Yellow River and returning empty were all swift.
translations.idiomatic: also built a thousand lighter boats and converted smaller transport craft; he personally camped on the riverbank to drive the work forward, and both the Yellow River crossing and the return trips moved swiftly.

sentences.zh: 迭疏論河務，宜引沁入衛，可利漕運。

translations.literal: In repeated memorials on river affairs he argued that diverting the Qin River into the Wei would benefit the grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In repeated memorials on river works he argued that diverting the Qin River into the Wei would benefit the grain transport.

sentences.zh: 又謂吳璥於黃泥嘴、俞家灘逢灣取直，以致停淤，為璥等論駁。

translations.literal: He also charged that Wu Jin, at Huangnizui and Yujiatan, had cut straight across bends and thereby caused stagnation and siltation, which Jin and others rebutted in debate.
translations.idiomatic: He also charged that at Huangnizui and Yujiatan Wu Jin had cut channels straight across bends, causing stagnation and siltation—a charge that Jin and others disputed.

sentences.zh: 复密陳吳璥、徐端所論不實，工程虛捏，自請調任總河察其弊，又薦蔣攸銛、孫玉庭可任。

translations.literal: He also secretly reported that the arguments of Wu Jin and Xu Duan were untrue and that engineering figures were fabricated, requested transfer to the post of Grand Canal Director to investigate the abuses, and recommended Jiang Youqian and Sun Yuting as capable men.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported in secret that Wu Jin and Xu Duan's claims were false and that engineering figures had been fabricated, asked to be transferred to grand canal director to investigate the abuses, and recommended Jiang Youqian and Sun Yuting as capable appointees.

sentences.zh: 帝以鬆筠忠實，治河非所長，用攸銛為河督，責令相助為理。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Song Yun loyal and honest but not expert in river control, appointed Youqian canal director and ordered Song Yun to assist in management.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, judging Song Yun loyal and honest but not expert in river control, appointed Youqian canal director and ordered Song Yun to assist him.

sentences.zh: 尋兼署河督事。

translations.literal: Soon he also acted concurrently as canal director.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served concurrently as acting canal director as well.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調兩廣總督，協辦大學士，兼內大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi, made Associate Grand Secretary, and concurrently an inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, Associate Grand Secretary, and an inner court minister as well.

sentences.zh: 召為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命往盛京會勘陵工，兼籌移駐宗室事，疏請小東門外建屋七十所，居閒散宗室七十戶，戶給田三十六畝。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to Mukden to jointly inspect tomb works and also plan relocation of imperial clansmen; he memorialized to build seventy houses outside the Small East Gate for seventy households of idle imperial clansmen, each household granted thirty-six mu of land.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was sent to Mukden to inspect tomb works and plan the relocation of imperial clansmen; he asked to build seventy houses outside the Small East Gate for seventy households of idle clansmen, granting each household thirty-six mu of land.

sentences.zh: 又言：「西廠大凌河東有可耕地三千頃，可移駐二千餘戶。

translations.literal: He also stated: "East of the Daling River at the western estate there are 3,000 qing of cultivable land, enough to resettle more than 2,000 households.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "East of the Daling River at the western estate lie three thousand qing of cultivable land, enough to resettle more than two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 東廠週數百里，地多積水，其水自北山柳條邊來，若相地開河，可涸出沃壤；

translations.literal: The eastern estate extends for several hundred li; much land is waterlogged, the water coming from the Willow Palisade in the northern hills—if suitable ground is chosen to open canals, fertile soil can be drained forth;
translations.idiomatic: The eastern estate covers hundreds of li; much of the land is waterlogged, the water coming from the Willow Palisade in the northern hills—if canals are opened in suitable places, fertile land can be reclaimed;

sentences.zh: 又東柳河溝亦多積水，若自北山東橫開大渠，可得沃壤數千頃。

translations.literal: the Dongliu River gully to the east is also much flooded—if a great canal is cut eastward across from the northern hills, several thousand qing of fertile land can be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: the Dongliu River gully to the east is also heavily flooded—if a major canal is cut eastward from the northern hills, several thousand qing of fertile land can be reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 」「續勘彰武台邊門外迤西牧廠閒地，橫三四十里，縱六七十里，並可移駐。

translations.literal: " Continuing the survey of idle pasture land west of the border gate outside Zhangwutai, thirty to forty li across and sixty to seventy li long, all could also receive resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: " A further survey found idle pasture west of the border gate outside Zhangwutai, thirty to forty li across and sixty to seventy li long, also suitable for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 請於大凌河西廠東界先試墾種。

translations.literal: He requested trial cultivation first on the eastern boundary of the western estate along the Daling River.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that trial cultivation begin first on the eastern boundary of the western estate along the Daling River.

sentences.zh: 」詔並允行。

translations.literal: " Edicts approved all of these proposals.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 而試墾事為將軍晉昌奏罷，論者惜之。

translations.literal: Yet the trial cultivation was halted by a memorial from General Jinchang, to the regret of commentators.
translations.idiomatic: But the trial cultivation was halted on the memorial of General Jinchang, to the regret of many observers.

sentences.zh: 回京，授軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On returning to the capital he was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he was made a Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 未幾罷，改授御前大臣。

translations.literal: Before long he was dismissed from that post and appointed instead an imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was removed from the council and appointed an imperial presence minister instead.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復出為伊犁將軍，拜東閣大學士，改武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was again sent out as General of Ili, appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and transferred to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was sent out again as general at Ili, made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and then transferred to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 以平定滑縣教匪，敘功，加太子太保。

translations.literal: For pacifying the sect rebels at Huaxian his merit was recorded and he was given the honorary title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: For helping pacify the sect rebels at Huaxian his service was rewarded and he was given the title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 詔偕參贊長齡通籌新疆南北諸城出納，量減內地饋運。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him together with Assistant Resident Changling to plan comprehensively the revenues and expenditures of all cities north and south in Xinjiang and reduce supplies transported from the interior as far as possible.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered, together with Assistant Resident Changling, to plan the revenues and expenditures of all cities in northern and southern Xinjiang and reduce supplies shipped from the interior as far as possible.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「北路塔爾巴哈台歲需內地銀四萬數千兩，南路回疆八城歲需內地銀五萬數千兩，地方貢賦皆入經費之內，無庸議減。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "On the northern route Tarbagatai requires more than 40,000 taels of silver annually from the interior; the eight cities of the southern route in Muslim Xinjiang require more than 50,000 taels—local tribute and levies are already counted within operating expenses and need not be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "On the northern route Tarbagatai needs more than forty thousand taels of silver from the interior each year; the eight cities of the southern Muslim territories need more than fifty thousand—local tribute and levies are already counted in operating expenses and need not be cut.

sentences.zh: 伊犁歲需內地經費銀六十萬兩，可撙節者無幾。

translations.literal: Ili requires 600,000 taels of operating funds from the interior annually; little can be economized.
translations.idiomatic: Ili needs six hundred thousand taels of operating funds from the interior each year; little can be saved there.

sentences.zh: 惟烏魯木齊為新疆腹地，歲需銀一百一十餘萬兩，宜裁減。

translations.literal: Only Urumqi, as the heartland of Xinjiang, requiring more than 1,100,000 taels annually, should be cut back.
translations.idiomatic: Only Urumqi, as the heartland of Xinjiang, which requires more than 1.1 million taels a year, should be reduced.

sentences.zh: 請復屯田，廣墾蘆灘荒地，開採銅鉛各礦，抽收迪化州、吐魯番木稅。

translations.literal: He requested restoration of military farming, wider reclamation of reed-marsh wasteland, opening of copper and lead mines, and collection of timber taxes at Dihua prefecture and Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for the restoration of military farming, wider reclamation of reed-marsh wasteland, the opening of copper and lead mines, and timber taxes at Dihua and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 」又議綠營糧餉，凡倉儲充裕處，改給銀米各半，並復乾隆四十六年以前捐監之例，使邊地就近納粟。

translations.literal: " He also discussed Green Standard Army grain and pay: wherever granaries were ample, half silver and half grain should be given, and the pre-46th year of Qianlong practice of purchase of office by grain donation should be restored so the frontier could deliver grain nearby.
translations.idiomatic: " He also proposed that wherever granaries were full, Green Standard troops receive half pay in silver and half in grain, and that the pre-46th year of Qianlong practice of purchasing office by grain donation be restored so the frontier could deliver grain locally.

sentences.zh: 所議或行或不行，於內地歲輸卒未大減。

translations.literal: Some proposals were adopted and some not; annual shipments from the interior were ultimately not greatly reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Some proposals were adopted and others not; annual shipments from the interior were never greatly reduced.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾阿奇木伯克玉努斯聽其妻色奇納言，多不法，私與浩罕酋愛瑪爾交通。

translations.literal: Yunus, the aqimu beg of Kashgar, obeyed his wife Sekina's words, committed many unlawful acts, and secretly communicated with Yar Muhammad, khan of Kokand.
translations.idiomatic: Yunus, the aqimu beg of Kashgar, followed his wife Sekina's counsel, committed many unlawful acts, and secretly dealt with Yar Muhammad, khan of Kokand.

sentences.zh: 愛瑪爾欲使尊為汗，遣使請自設哈子伯克，用浩罕稅例徵安集延商。

translations.literal: Yar Muhammad wished to have him honored as khan, sent envoys requesting permission to appoint his own khoja begs, and to levy taxes on Andijan merchants by Kokand's tax rules.
translations.idiomatic: Yar Muhammad wanted him honored as khan, sent envoys asking permission to appoint his own khoja begs, and to tax Andijan merchants under Kokand's tariff rules.

sentences.zh: 十九年，松筠巡視回疆，誅色奇納，械玉努斯，禁錮伊犁；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Song Yun toured Muslim Xinjiang, executed Sekina, put Yunus in the cangue, and imprisoned him at Ili;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Song Yun toured Muslim Xinjiang, executed Sekina, put Yunus in shackles, and imprisoned him at Ili;

sentences.zh: 拒浩罕之請，斥去其使。

translations.literal: he refused Kokand's requests and dismissed its envoys.
translations.idiomatic: he refused Kokand's requests and sent its envoys away.

sentences.zh: 二十年，喀什噶爾回人仔牙敦作亂，親往治之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Kashgar Muslim Ziyadun rebelled, and he went in person to deal with it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Kashgar Muslim Ziyadun rebelled, and Song Yun went in person to suppress the uprising.

sentences.zh: 仔牙敦就獲，與布魯特比圖爾第邁莫特並置極刑。

translations.literal: Ziyadun was captured and, together with the Kirghiz chief Turtay Maimat, was put to the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyadun was captured and, together with the Kirghiz chief Turtay Maimat, was executed.

sentences.zh: 詔斥松筠不待命，削宮銜，召還京。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Song Yun for not awaiting orders, stripped his court titles, and recalled him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Song Yun for acting without awaiting orders, stripped his court honors, and recalled him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 松筠初任時，築四堡於伊犁河北，議移置八旗散丁，事未竟而去。

translations.literal: On his first term Song Yun built four forts north of the Ili River and planned to resettle idle banner households there, but left before the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: During his first term Song Yun built four forts north of the Ili River and planned to resettle idle banner households there, but left before the project was complete.

sentences.zh: 再至，乃築室堡中，堡置百戶，戶授田三四十畝，三時務農，冬則肄武。

translations.literal: On his return he built dwellings within the forts; each fort held a hundred households, each granted thirty to forty mu, farming in the three seasons and drilling in arms in winter.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he built houses within the forts; each fort held a hundred households, each granted thirty to forty mu, farming through three seasons and drilling in arms in winter.

sentences.zh: 規畫粗備，以屬代者，而代者不置意，田遂荒。

translations.literal: The plan was roughly complete and entrusted to his successor, but the successor paid no attention and the fields fell into waste.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was largely complete and handed to his successor, but the successor paid no attention and the fields went back to waste.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，詔來年幸盛京，抗疏諫阻，罷大學士，出為察哈爾都統，署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year an edict announced that the emperor would visit Mukden the following year; Song Yun submitted a remonstrance in opposition, was dismissed as grand secretary, sent out as Chahar commander, and acted as garrison general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year an edict announced an imperial visit to Mukden the following year; Song Yun remonstrated against it, was removed as grand secretary, sent out as Chahar commander, and served as acting garrison general at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 逾年，子熙昌歿，帝憐之，召還為正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: More than a year later his son Xichang died; the emperor took pity on him and recalled him as commander of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than a year later his son Xichang died; the emperor took pity on him and recalled him as commander of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 尋授禮部尚書，調兵部，复御前兼職。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Minister of Rites, transferred to the Board of War, and again given concurrent imperial presence duties.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Minister of Rites, transferred to the Board of War, and again given concurrent duties at imperial presence.

sentences.zh: 未幾，出為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as General of Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as general of Mukden.

sentences.zh: 松筠素以忠諒見重，在朝時，凡燕遊執御之事，乘間直言無避。

translations.literal: Song Yun had long been esteemed for loyalty and candor; while at court, on matters of banquets, excursions, and imperial equipage, he seized opportunities to speak frankly without evasion.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun had long been valued for loyalty and candor; at court, on matters of banquets, excursions, and imperial equipage, he seized every chance to speak frankly without holding back.

sentences.zh: 既屢忤旨，二十五年，以兵部遺失行印，追論，降山海關副都統。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly offended the throne, in the twenty-fifth year, because the Board of War had lost an official traveling seal, he was pursued in judgment and demoted to vice commander at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Having repeatedly displeased the throne, in the twenty-fifth year the loss of an official traveling seal at the Board of War was held against him and he was demoted to vice commander at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 復以事，迭降為驍騎校。

translations.literal: On further charges he was demoted in succession to commandant of the Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On further charges he was demoted step by step to commandant of the Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，仁宗崩於熱河，梓宮回京，宣宗步行於班僚中見之，扶而哭，翌日授左副都御史，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: That autumn the Jiaqing emperor died at Rehe; as the coffin returned to the capital, the Xuanzong emperor walked among the officials, saw him, supported him and wept; the next day he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Jiaqing emperor died at Rehe; as the coffin returned to the capital, the future Daoguang emperor walked among the officials, saw Song Yun, supported him and wept; the next day Song Yun was made Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and then Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 其復起也，甚負時望，然卒不安於位，未一月，出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: His restoration carried great public expectation, yet he could not remain secure in office; within a month he was sent out as commander at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: His return to office aroused great public hope, yet he could not hold his position; within a month he was sent out as commander at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，召授兵部尚書，調吏部，復為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was summoned as Minister of War, transferred to the Board of Civil Appointments, and again made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he was recalled as Minister of War, transferred to the Board of Civil Appointments, and again made a Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 二年，暫署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the second year he temporarily acted as Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he served temporarily as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 以代改理籓院奏稿，忤尚書禧恩，被劾，降六部員外郎。

translations.literal: For altering on another's behalf a memorial draft of the Court of Colonial Affairs, he offended Minister Xi'en, was impeached, and demoted to vice director in one of the Six Boards.
translations.idiomatic: For altering a memorial draft of the Court of Colonial Affairs on someone else's behalf, he offended Minister Xi'en, was impeached, and demoted to vice director in one of the Six Boards.

sentences.zh: 尋授光祿寺卿，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and then Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 又出為盛京將軍，調吉林。

translations.literal: He was again sent out as General of Mukden and transferred to Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent out as general of Mukden and then transferred to Jilin.

sentences.zh: 數年之中，兩召還朝，為左都御史、禮部尚書；

translations.literal: Within a few years he was twice recalled to court as Left Censor-in-Chief and Minister of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years he was twice recalled to court as Left Censor-in-Chief and Minister of Rites;

sentences.zh: 迭出署烏里雅蘇台將軍、熱河都統、直隸總督。

translations.literal: and repeatedly sent out to act as General of Uliastai, commander at Rehe, and Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: and repeatedly sent out to serve as acting general of Uliastai, commander at Rehe, and governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 九年，調兵部尚書，往科布多鞫獄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Minister of War and sent to Kobdo to conduct a trial.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made Minister of War and sent to Kobdo to conduct a trial.

sentences.zh: 十年，往山西按巡撫徐炘被控事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he went to Shanxi to investigate charges against Governor Xu Xin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he went to Shanxi to investigate charges against Governor Xu Xin.

sentences.zh: 回疆方用兵，密疏有所論列，詔令陳善後方略，多被採納。

translations.literal: While Muslim Xinjiang was at war, in a secret memorial he set forth various proposals; an edict ordered him to present postwar plans, many of which were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: While Muslim Xinjiang was at war, he set forth various proposals in a secret memorial; the throne ordered him to present postwar plans, many of which were adopted.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，自以衰病請罷，數日復請任使，詔斥進退自由，負優禮大臣之意。

translations.literal: That autumn, citing age and illness, he requested retirement; a few days later he again asked for appointment; an edict rebuked him for treating advancement and withdrawal as he pleased, contrary to the court's gracious treatment of senior ministers.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he asked to retire on grounds of age and illness; a few days later he asked for appointment again; an edict rebuked him for treating office as a matter of personal choice, contrary to the court's gracious treatment of senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 又以前赴科布多囑道員徐寅代購什物，罷職，予三品頂戴休致。

translations.literal: Again, for having on his way to Kobdo asked Circuit Intendant Xu Yin to purchase goods on his behalf, he was dismissed from office and granted retirement with third-rank button.
translations.idiomatic: He was again dismissed for having asked Circuit Intendant Xu Yin to purchase goods for him on his way to Kobdo, and was granted retirement with third-rank button.

sentences.zh: 至十二年，浩罕遣使進表，松筠曾言浩罕通商，邊境可靖，帝思其言，复頭品頂戴，署正黃旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: By the twelfth year Kokand sent envoys with a memorial; Song Yun had once said that trade with Kokand could pacify the frontier—the emperor recalled his words, restored his first-rank button, and appointed him acting vice commander of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth year Kokand sent envoys with a memorial; the emperor recalled Song Yun's earlier argument that trade with Kokand could pacify the frontier, restored his first-rank button, and appointed him acting vice commander of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 命赴歸化城勘達爾漢、茂明安、土默特三部爭地，據乾隆朝圖記判定，三部皆悅服。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Guihua city to investigate a land dispute among the Darhan, Maoming'an, and Tumed tribes; judging by maps and records from the Qianlong reign, all three tribes were satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Guihua city to settle a land dispute among the Darhan, Maoming'an, and Tumed tribes; judging by Qianlong-era maps and records, all three tribes accepted the decision.

sentences.zh: 還，授理籓院侍郎，調工部，進正藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Vice President of the Court of Colonial Affairs, transferred to the Board of Works, and advanced to commander of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made Vice President of the Court of Colonial Affairs, transferred to the Board of Works, and promoted to commander of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以都統銜休致。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he retired with banner commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he retired with banner commander rank.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，年八十有二，贈太子太保，依尚書例賜卹，諡文清，祀伊犁名宦祠。

translations.literal: More than a year later he died at the age of eighty-two; he was posthumously given Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, condolence according to ministerial precedent, posthumous title Wenqing, and enshrined in the hall of eminent officials at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than a year later he died at eighty-two; he was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted ministerial funeral honors, given the posthumous name Wenqing, and enshrined in the hall of eminent officials at Ili.

sentences.zh: 松筠廉直坦易，脫略文法，不隨時俯仰，屢起屢蹶。

translations.literal: Song Yun was honest, upright, and open, careless of formal propriety, unwilling to bow to the times; he rose and fell repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun was honest, upright, and open, careless of formal propriety, unwilling to bend with the times; he rose and fell again and again.

sentences.zh: 晚年益多挫折，剛果不克如前，實心為國，未嘗改也。

translations.literal: In his later years setbacks grew more frequent; his firmness could not match his earlier self, yet his sincere devotion to the state never changed.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years setbacks grew more frequent and his firmness no longer matched his earlier self, yet his sincere devotion to the state never changed.

sentences.zh: 服膺宋儒，亦喜談禪。

translations.literal: He adhered to Song Neo-Confucian learning and also enjoyed discussing Chan Buddhism.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Song Neo-Confucian learning and also enjoyed discussing Chan Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 尤施惠貧民，名滿海內，要以治邊功最多。

translations.literal: He especially bestowed kindness on the poor; his fame filled the realm, yet his greatest achievements lay in governing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially generous to the poor; his fame spread throughout the realm, yet his greatest achievements lay in governing the frontier.

sentences.zh: 子熙昌，以廕生官至刑、工兩部侍郎，署熱河都統兼護軍統領。

translations.literal: His son Xichang, through hereditary privilege, rose to vice-president of both the Boards of Punishments and Works, and acted as commander at Rehe while concurrently commanding the Guard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xichang, entering service by hereditary privilege, rose to vice-president of both the Boards of Punishments and Works, and served as acting commander at Rehe while commanding the Guard Corps.

sentences.zh: 數奉使赴各省按事，亦被信用。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly sent on missions to various provinces to investigate affairs and was also trusted.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly sent on missions to various provinces to investigate affairs and enjoyed the court's trust.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十三年，卒於長沙，帝深惜之，贈都統，諡敬慎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiaqing he died at Changsha; the emperor deeply regretted it, posthumously granted him banner commander rank, and gave the posthumous title Jingshen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Jiaqing he died at Changsha; the emperor deeply regretted his loss, posthumously granted him banner commander rank, and gave him the posthumous name Jingshen.

sentences.zh: 富俊，字松岩，卓特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Jun, style Songyan, of the Zhuote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun, whose style was Songyan, belonged to the Zhuote clan and was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 繙譯進士，授禮部主事，歷郎中。

translations.literal: A translation jinshi, he was appointed a secretary in the Board of Rites and rose through the ranks to director.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the translation jinshi examination, he was appointed a secretary in the Board of Rites and rose to director.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣蒙古侍讀學士、內閣學士，兼副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Mongol Reader of the Grand Secretariat, Grand Secretariat academician, and concurrently vice banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in stages to Mongol Reader of the Grand Secretariat, grand secretary academician, and vice banner commander as well.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，擢兵部侍郎，充科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and appointed Assistant Resident at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to vice minister of war and appointed assistant resident at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 四年，授烏魯木齊都統，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed commander at Urumqi and transferred to Kashgar Assistant Resident.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made commander at Urumqi and transferred to assistant resident at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 歷葉爾羌辦事大臣、烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Resident Minister at Yarkand and Assistant Resident at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as resident minister at Yarkand and assistant resident at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 召署鑲紅旗漢軍都統、兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was summoned to act as commander of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Army and Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as acting commander of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Army and vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 八年，出為吉林將軍，調盛京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was sent out as General of Jilin and transferred to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was sent out as general of Jilin and transferred to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 清治民典旗地，限年首官，不首者治罪，追典價租息入官。

translations.literal: In clearing cases of commoners mortgaging banner land, a one-year limit was set for reporting to officials; those who did not report were punished, and mortgage prices and rent interest were recovered for the state.
translations.idiomatic: In clearing cases of commoners mortgaging banner land, officials set a one-year limit for reporting; those who failed to report were punished, and mortgage prices and rent interest were recovered for the state.

sentences.zh: 富俊疏言：「一年之內，一千六百餘案，應追繳者不下萬人，年久轉典，株連繁多。

translations.literal: Fu Jun memorialized: "Within one year there were more than 1,600 cases, and no fewer than ten thousand persons subject to recovery; as mortgages passed down through years, implicated parties multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun reported: "Within one year there were more than sixteen hundred cases and no fewer than ten thousand people subject to recovery; as mortgages passed down through the years, the number of people implicated multiplied.

sentences.zh: 旗、民多窮苦，既獲罪，又迫追呼，情實可憫，請悉寬免。

translations.literal: Bannermen and commoners are mostly poor; having already been punished, they are again pressed for payment—the situation is truly pitiable; I request complete remission.
translations.idiomatic: Bannermen and commoners are mostly poor; having already been punished, they are pressed again for payment—the situation is truly pitiable; I ask that all such debts be remitted.

sentences.zh: 」允之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二年，考覈軍政，以潔己奉公，邊陲安輯，特詔褒美，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, in the military administration review, for integrity in office and pacification of the frontier, a special edict praised him and granted consideration for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the military administration review, for integrity in office and keeping the frontier peaceful, a special edict praised him and ordered that his service be considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 十五年，因採葠攙雜，受屬員蔽，褫職，遣往吉林效力。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because ginseng he collected was adulterated and he was misled by subordinates, he was stripped of office and sent to Jilin to serve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, because collected ginseng was adulterated and he had been misled by subordinates, he was stripped of office and sent to Jilin to serve.

sentences.zh: 既而言官論關東三省賭博風熾，仁宗念富俊在官時曾嚴禁，即起授盛京工部侍郎，兼管奉天府尹及六邊邊門事務。

translations.literal: Soon censors discussed the fierce gambling in the three eastern provinces; the Jiaqing emperor, recalling that Fu Jun had strictly forbidden it while in office, immediately restored him as Vice Minister of Works at Mukden, concurrently supervising the Fengtian prefect and the six frontier gates.
translations.idiomatic: Soon censors reported rampant gambling in the three eastern provinces; the Jiaqing emperor, recalling that Fu Jun had strictly forbidden it while in office, immediately restored him as vice minister of works at Mukden, with concurrent charge of the Fengtian prefect and the six frontier gates.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授黑龍江將軍，疏請內外臣工三年更調，及禁奢、講武數事，詔以更調非可限年，餘並嘉納。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed General of Heilongjiang and memorialized requesting rotation of inner and outer officials every three years, prohibition of luxury, military drill, and other matters; an edict held that rotation could not be fixed by years, but the rest was commended and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was appointed general of Heilongjiang and memorialized asking that inner and outer officials be rotated every three years, along with proposals to curb luxury and emphasize military drill; an edict held that rotation could not be fixed by years, but the rest was commended and accepted.

sentences.zh: 又以東三省官兵技藝優嫺，每屆五年挑送京營，著為令。

translations.literal: Because troops of the three eastern provinces were skilled in drill, every five years the best were selected and sent to the capital garrisons—this was made a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Because troops in the three eastern provinces were highly skilled, the best were selected every five years and sent to the capital garrisons—a practice codified as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 十九年，調吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 先是，議籌八旗生計，詔勘吉林荒地開墾，移駐京旗，將軍賽衝阿言拉林近地閒荒可墾，未有規畫。

translations.literal: Earlier, in planning livelihoods for the Eight Banners, an edict ordered survey of wasteland in Jilin for opening cultivation and resettlement of capital banner households; General Saichong'a said idle land near Lalin could be cultivated but no plan had been made.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while planning livelihoods for the Eight Banners, the throne ordered a survey of Jilin wasteland for cultivation and resettlement of capital banner households; General Saichong'a reported that idle land near Lalin could be farmed, but no plan had yet been drawn up.

sentences.zh: 富俊至，疏言：「乾隆中移駐京旗，建屋墾地，多藉吉林兵力，墾而不種，酌留數人教耕，一年後裁汰。

translations.literal: When Fu Jun arrived, he memorialized: "In the Qianlong period, when capital banner households were resettled, houses were built and land opened, relying heavily on Jilin troops; land was opened but not planted—a few men were kept to teach farming and then dismissed after a year.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu Jun arrived, he reported: "Under Qianlong, when capital banner households were resettled, houses were built and land cleared, relying heavily on Jilin troops; land was cleared but not planted—a few men were kept to teach farming and then dismissed after a year.

sentences.zh: 京旗蘇拉不能耕作，始而僱覓流民，久之田為民有，殊失國家愛育旗人之意。

translations.literal: Capital banner sutlers could not farm; at first they hired wandering commoners, but in time the fields became commoners' property—far from the state's intent to nurture bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Capital banner sutlers could not farm; at first they hired wandering commoners, but in time the fields passed into commoners' hands—far from the state's intent to nurture bannermen.

sentences.zh: 今籌試墾，莫若先辦屯田。

translations.literal: In planning trial cultivation now, nothing is better than first establishing military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: In planning trial cultivation now, the best approach is to establish military colonies first.

sentences.zh: 請發吉林閒散旗人一千名為屯丁，每丁給銀二十五兩、耔種二石，官置牛具，人給荒地三十晌。

translations.literal: He requested dispatch of a thousand idle bannermen from Jilin as colonists; each was to receive twenty-five taels of silver, two piculs of seed grain, official provision of oxen and tools, and thirty shang of wasteland per man.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a thousand idle bannermen from Jilin be sent as colonists; each would receive twenty-five taels of silver, two piculs of seed grain, oxen and tools from the state, and thirty shang of wasteland per man.

sentences.zh: 墾種二十晌，留荒十晌，四年徵糧，每晌一石。

translations.literal: Twenty shang were to be cultivated, ten left waste; after four years grain tax was levied at one picul per shang.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty shang were to be cultivated and ten left waste; after four years grain tax would be levied at one picul per shang.

sentences.zh: 十年後移駐京旗，人給熟地十五晌，荒五晌，餘十晌荒、熟各半，給原駐屯丁為忄互產，免徵其租。

translations.literal: After ten years capital banner households would be resettled; each man would receive fifteen shang of cultivated land and five of waste; the remaining ten shang, half waste and half cultivated, would be given the original colonists as hereditary property, exempt from rent.
translations.idiomatic: After ten years capital banner households would be resettled; each man would receive fifteen shang of cultivated land and five of waste; the remaining ten shang, half waste and half cultivated, would be given the original colonists as hereditary property, exempt from rent.

sentences.zh: 因利而利，糜帑無多，將來京旗移到，得種熟地，與本處旗屯犬牙相錯，學耕夥種，實為有益。

translations.literal: Profiting through profit, treasury expenditure would not be great; when capital banner households later moved in they would obtain cultivated land, interlocking with local banner colonies to learn farming and joint planting—truly beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: The plan would pay for itself with little treasury outlay; when capital banner households later moved in they would obtain cultivated land, interlocking with local banner colonies to learn farming and plant together—a real benefit.

sentences.zh: 」並詳列屯墾、出納、設官、經理事宜，詔如議行。

translations.literal: " He also detailed matters of colonization, receipts and disbursements, official appointments, and administration; an edict ordered implementation as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " He also set out in detail colonization, finances, official appointments, and administration; an edict ordered the plan carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 二十年，富俊親駐雙城子，地在拉林河西北，橫一百三十里，縱七十餘裡，沃衍宜耕。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Fu Jun personally stationed himself at Shuangchengzi, northwest of the Lalin River, one hundred thirty li across and more than seventy li long, fertile and fit for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Fu Jun personally took post at Shuangchengzi, northwest of the Lalin River, one hundred thirty li across and more than seventy li long—fertile land well suited to farming.

sentences.zh: 遣員履丈，分撥伐木於拉林河上游，建立屯屋。

translations.literal: He sent officials to survey on foot, allocated logging in the upper Lalin River, and built colony houses.
translations.idiomatic: He sent officials to survey the land, allocated logging in the upper Lalin River, and built colony houses.

sentences.zh: 分五屯，設協領一、佐領二，分左右翼統治之，即名屯地曰雙城堡，於二十一年一律開墾。

translations.literal: The land was divided into five colonies with one assistant commander and two company commanders, governing left and right wings; the colony lands were named Shuangcheng Fort, and in the twenty-first year cultivation was opened uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: The land was divided into five colonies with one assistant commander and two company commanders governing left and right wings; the settlement was named Shuangcheng Fort, and in the twenty-first year cultivation began throughout.

sentences.zh: 是年霜早歉收，屯丁僅足餬口，又挈妻子者不敷居住，間有逃亡。
