translations.literal: That year early frost brought a poor harvest; colonists had barely enough to eat, and those who brought wives and children lacked adequate housing; some fled.
translations.idiomatic: That year early frost brought a poor harvest; colonists had barely enough to eat, and those who brought wives and children lacked adequate housing; some fled.

sentences.zh: 乃展緩徵糧一年，添蓋窩棚，借給耔種，心始安。

translations.literal: He then extended grain tax relief by one year, added hut shelters, and lent seed grain; hearts were finally calmed.
translations.idiomatic: He then deferred grain tax for one year, added hut shelters, and lent seed grain; the colonists were finally reassured.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，調盛京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 疏陳雙城堡餘荒尚多，續發盛京、吉林旗丁各千名往墾，分左、右二屯，舊屯名為中屯，遂復調富俊吉林，任其事。

translations.literal: He memorialized that much waste land remained at Shuangcheng Fort and requested another thousand banner troops each from Mukden and Jilin to cultivate, divided into left and right colonies with the old colony named the central colony; Fu Jun was then transferred back to Jilin to manage the affair.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that much waste land remained at Shuangcheng Fort and asked for another thousand banner troops each from Mukden and Jilin to farm it, divided into left and right colonies with the old colony renamed the central colony; Fu Jun was then transferred back to Jilin to oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，先到屯丁千名，盛京旗人多有親族偕來，自原入屯，惟隸寧古塔者，因近地亦可耕荒，不原輕離鄉土，聽其還，以空額二百名改撥盛京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the first thousand colonists arrived; many Mukden bannermen brought relatives and entered colonies willingly, but those under Ningguta, because nearby land could also be opened, were unwilling to leave their native place lightly—they were allowed to return, and two hundred vacant places were reassigned to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the first thousand colonists arrived; many Mukden bannermen brought relatives and entered colonies willingly, but those under Ningguta, because nearby land could also be farmed, were unwilling to leave home—they were allowed to return, and two hundred vacant places were reassigned to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，复續到千名。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year another thousand arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year another thousand arrived.

sentences.zh: 富俊巡曆三屯，疏陳：「比屋環居，安土樂業，有井田遺風。

translations.literal: Fu Jun toured the three colonies and memorialized: "Houses stand ring upon ring; the people are settled and content in their work, with something of the ancient well-field tradition.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun toured the three colonies and reported: "Houses stand ring upon ring; the people are settled and content in their work, with something of the ancient well-field tradition.

sentences.zh: 中屯開墾在先，麥苗暢發，男耕婦饁，俱極勤勞。

translations.literal: The central colony was opened first; wheat and seedlings flourish; men plow and women bring food—all are extremely industrious.
translations.idiomatic: The central colony was opened first; wheat and seedlings flourish; men plow and women bring food—all work with great industry.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗大悅，報曰：「滿洲故里，佃田宅宅，洵善事也。

translations.literal: " The Jiaqing emperor was greatly pleased and replied: "In the Manchu homeland, tilling fields and building homes—truly a good deed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Jiaqing emperor was greatly pleased and replied: "In the Manchu homeland, tilling fields and building homes—truly a worthy undertaking.

sentences.zh: 」續議三屯應增事宜，詔嘉實心任事，予議敘。

translations.literal: " He continued to discuss matters requiring addition for the three colonies; an edict commended his sincere service and granted consideration for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: " He continued to discuss further measures for the three colonies; an edict commended his sincere service and ordered that his merit be considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，疏言：「三屯開墾九萬數千晌，已著成效，可移駐京旗三千戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he memorialized: "The three colonies have opened more than ninety thousand shang with clear results; three thousand capital banner households can be resettled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he reported: "The three colonies have opened more than ninety thousand shang with clear results; three thousand capital banner households can be resettled.

sentences.zh: 請自道光四年始，每歲移駐二百戶，給資裝車馬，分起送屯，官給房屋牛具。

translations.literal: He requested that from the fourth year of Daoguang two hundred households be resettled annually, with travel funds, carts and horses, dispatched in groups to the colonies, and official provision of houses, cattle, and tools.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that from the fourth year of Daoguang two hundred households be resettled each year, with travel funds, carts and horses, sent in groups to the colonies, and official provision of houses, cattle, and tools.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二年，召授理籓院尚書，與玉瀾堂十五老臣宴，御製詩有「勤勞三省，不凋松柏」之褒。

translations.literal: In the second year he was summoned as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and banqueted with the fifteen elder statesmen at the Hall of Jade Ripples; an imperial poem praised him with the lines "toiling in three provinces, an unfading pine or cypress."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was recalled as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and banqueted with the fifteen elder statesmen at the Hall of Jade Ripples; an imperial poem praised him with the lines "toiling in three provinces, an unfading pine or cypress."

sentences.zh: 四年，復出為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was again sent out as General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was sent out again as general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 方雙城堡之興屯也，富俊欲推其法於伯都訥圍場，以旗戶往往賴幫丁助耕，不如迳招民墾。

translations.literal: When Shuangcheng Fort colonies were being established, Fu Jun wished to extend the method to the Budune hunting preserve, since banner households often relied on hired helpers to farm and it would be better to recruit commoners directly for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuangcheng Fort colonies were being established, Fu Jun wished to extend the method to the Budune hunting preserve, since banner households often relied on hired helpers to farm and it would be better to recruit commoners directly for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 前後疏六七上，為廷議所格。

translations.literal: He memorialized six or seven times before and after, but court deliberation blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized six or seven times, but court deliberation blocked the proposal each time.

sentences.zh: 至是，復言伯都訥圍場荒地二十餘萬晌，募民屯墾，較雙城堡費半功倍，始允之。

translations.literal: At this point he again stated that the Budune preserve had more than two hundred thousand shang of waste land; recruiting commoners for colony cultivation would cost half the effort for twice the result—and permission was finally granted.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he again reported that the Budune preserve had more than two hundred thousand shang of waste land; recruiting commoners for colony farming would cost half the effort for twice the result—and permission was finally granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，丈地分屯，申畫經界，名曰新城屯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year land was measured and colonies divided, boundaries marked out, and the settlement named New City Colony.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the land was surveyed and colonies laid out, boundaries marked, and the settlement named New City Colony.

sentences.zh: 分八旗為兩翼，每翼初立二十五屯，後定為十五屯。

translations.literal: The Eight Banners were divided into two wings; each wing initially had twenty-five colonies, later fixed at fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Banners were divided into two wings; each wing initially had twenty-five colonies, later fixed at fifteen.

sentences.zh: 每屯三十戶，以「治本於​​農務滋稼穡」八字為號。

translations.literal: Each colony had thirty households, named by the eight characters "Governance rooted in farming, labor nourishing grain."
translations.idiomatic: Each colony had thirty households, named by the eight characters "Governance rooted in farming, labor nourishing grain."

sentences.zh: 以次撥地，同時並墾。

translations.literal: Land was allocated in order and cultivated all at once.
translations.idiomatic: Land was allocated in order and cultivated all at once.

sentences.zh: 至七年，陸續認佃三千六百戶，總為一百二十屯，與雙城堡相為表裡。

translations.literal: By the seventh year, three thousand six hundred households had taken tenancy in succession, totaling one hundred twenty colonies, complementing Shuangcheng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh year, three thousand six hundred households had taken tenancy in succession, forming one hundred twenty colonies that complemented Shuangcheng Fort.

sentences.zh: 初議京旗每歲二百戶移駐雙城堡，至六年，僅陸續移到二百七十戶；

translations.literal: It was initially proposed that two hundred capital banner households be resettled at Shuangcheng Fort each year; by the sixth year only two hundred seventy had moved in succession;
translations.idiomatic: It was initially proposed that two hundred capital banner households be resettled at Shuangcheng Fort each year; by the sixth year only two hundred seventy had moved in succession;

sentences.zh: 七年，續移八十五戶：而地利頓興，自此雙城堡、伯都訥兩地號邊方繁庶之區焉。

translations.literal: in the seventh year another eighty-five households moved: the land's advantages flourished at once, and from then on Shuangcheng Fort and Budune were called the prosperous regions of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: in the seventh year another eighty-five households moved; the land's advantages flourished at once, and from then on Shuangcheng Fort and Budune were known as the prosperous regions of the frontier.

sentences.zh: 墾事既定，復召為理籓院尚書，協辦大學士，兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: When colonization was settled, he was again summoned as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Associate Grand Secretary, and concurrently commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: When colonization was settled, he was recalled as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Associate Grand Secretary, and commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army as well.

sentences.zh: 次年，京察，以在吉林宣勞，予議敘。

translations.literal: The following year, in the capital evaluation, for proclaiming merit at Jilin he was granted consideration for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the capital evaluation, for his service at Jilin he was granted consideration for promotion.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「京、外競尚浮奢，官民服飾及冠婚、喪祭，任意踰制，有關風俗人心。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In the capital and provinces alike extravagance is competitively pursued; officials and commoners in dress and in capping, marriage, mourning, and sacrifice arbitrarily exceed regulations—this concerns custom and public morale.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "In the capital and provinces alike extravagance is competitively pursued; officials and commoners in dress and in capping, marriage, mourning, and sacrifice arbitrarily exceed regulations—this bears on custom and public morale.

sentences.zh: 請依會典儀制，刊布規條，宣諭民間。

translations.literal: I request that regulations be published according to the Collected Statutes and ritual codes and proclaimed to the people.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that regulations be published according to the Collected Statutes and ritual codes and proclaimed to the people.

sentences.zh: 」詔下有司議行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate and implement.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate and implement.

sentences.zh: 時富俊年逾八十，渥被優禮，遇常朝免其入直。

translations.literal: At this time Fu Jun was over eighty, richly favored with gracious treatment, and exempted from regular court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Fu Jun was over eighty, richly favored by the court, and exempted from regular attendance.

sentences.zh: 迭讞獄盛京、吉林，俱稱旨。

translations.literal: He repeatedly judged cases at Mukden and Jilin, all meeting imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly judged cases at Mukden and Jilin, all meeting imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 十年，調工部，拜東閣大學士，管理理籓院。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Board of Works, appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Board of Works, made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二年，復請禁僭用服色，犯者拿捕，詔斥徒滋擾累，寢其議。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he again requested prohibition of usurped dress and colors, with offenders arrested; an edict rebuked this as merely increasing harassment and set the proposal aside.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he again asked to prohibit usurped dress and colors, with offenders arrested; an edict rebuked this as merely increasing harassment and set the proposal aside.

sentences.zh: 尋以天時亢旱，自稱奉職無狀，引年乞罷，不許。

translations.literal: Soon, because of severe drought, he declared himself unworthy in office and requested retirement on grounds of age; permission was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, citing severe drought, he declared himself unworthy in office and asked to retire on grounds of age; permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 授內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed an inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「科舉保薦，並認師生，餽遺關通，成為陋習。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In civil examinations and recommendations, teacher-student ties are claimed, gifts and favor-trading abound—this has become a corrupt practice.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "In civil examinations and recommendations, teacher-student ties are claimed, gifts and favor-trading abound—this has become a corrupt practice.

sentences.zh: 請嚴禁，以端仕進。

translations.literal: I request strict prohibition to rectify advancement in office.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that this be strictly forbidden to rectify advancement in office.

sentences.zh: 」詔嘉納，申誡臣工務除積習。

translations.literal: " An edict commended and accepted this and admonished officials to eliminate entrenched habits.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict commended and accepted this and admonished officials to eliminate entrenched habits.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 帝悼惜，稱其「清慎公勤，克盡厥職」，贈太子太傅，親臨奠醊，諡文誠，入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: The emperor mourned him, praising him as "honest, cautious, fair, and diligent, fully fulfilling his duties," posthumously granting Senior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, personally attending the libation, giving the posthumous title Wencheng, and enshrining him in the Hall of Worthy Officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him, praising him as "honest, cautious, fair, and diligent, fully fulfilling his duties," posthumously making him Senior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, personally attending the libation, giving him the posthumous name Wencheng, and enshrining him in the Hall of Worthy Officials.

sentences.zh: 富俊尚廉節，好禮賢士。

translations.literal: Fu Jun valued integrity and frugality and delighted in honoring worthy scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun valued integrity and frugality and delighted in honoring worthy scholars.

sentences.zh: 在吉林時，請調黑龍江戍員馬瑞辰掌教白山書院，且被嚴斥。

translations.literal: While at Jilin he requested transfer of the Heilongjiang garrison officer Ma Ruichen to head the Baishan Academy, and was severely rebuked for it.
translations.idiomatic: While at Jilin he asked that Heilongjiang garrison officer Ma Ruichen be transferred to head the Baishan Academy, and was severely rebuked for it.

sentences.zh: 其治屯墾，專任竇心傳，卒以成功。

translations.literal: In governing colonization he relied exclusively on Dou Xinchuan and ultimately succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In governing colonization he relied exclusively on Dou Xinchuan and ultimately succeeded.

sentences.zh: 心傳，山西人。

translations.literal: Xinchuan was a native of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xinchuan was a native of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 以進士官奉天寧海知縣，坐東巡治御道有誤，罷職。

translations.literal: As a jinshi he served as magistrate of Ninghai in Fengtian; for errors in preparing the imperial road during the eastern tour he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: As a jinshi he served as magistrate of Ninghai in Fengtian; for errors in preparing the imperial road during the eastern tour he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 富俊知其才，闢佐墾務，規畫悉出手定，始終在事，以勞复官。

translations.literal: Fu Jun recognized his talent, recruited him to assist colonization affairs, and all planning came from his hand; he remained throughout and was restored to office for his labor.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun recognized his talent, recruited him to assist colonization, and all planning came from his hand; he remained throughout and was restored to office for his service.

sentences.zh: 世比諸陳潢之佐靳輔治河。

translations.literal: The age compared him to Chen Huang assisting Jin Fu in river control.
translations.idiomatic: His contemporaries compared him to Chen Huang assisting Jin Fu in river control.

sentences.zh: 博啟圖，一等誠嘉毅勇公明瑞孫。

translations.literal: Bo Qitu was grandson of Mingrui, first-rank Duke of Sincere, Commendable, Resolute, and Brave.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Qitu was the grandson of Mingrui, first-rank Duke of Sincere, Commendable, Resolute, and Brave.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初襲爵，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he inherited the title and was appointed a first-rank guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jiaqing he inherited the title and was appointed a first-rank guard.

sentences.zh: 歷兵部侍郎、察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Vice Minister of War and Chahar commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as vice minister of war and Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 道光七年，調吉林將軍，繼富俊之後，守其成規。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daoguang he was transferred to General of Jilin, succeeding Fu Jun and maintaining his established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Daoguang he was transferred to general of Jilin, succeeding Fu Jun and maintaining his established regulations.

sentences.zh: 治邊有法，富俊請以屯墾專任之。

translations.literal: He governed the frontier with method; Fu Jun had requested that colonization be his sole charge.
translations.idiomatic: He governed the frontier with method; Fu Jun had asked that colonization be his sole responsibility.

sentences.zh: 時京旗以邊地早寒，又助耕乏人，原往者少。

translations.literal: At the time capital banner households, because the frontier was early cold and helpers for farming were scarce, were few in wishing to go.
translations.idiomatic: At the time capital banner households, because the frontier was early cold and farm labor was scarce, were reluctant to go.

sentences.zh: 博啟圖疏請減戶增田，許其買僕代耕，統居中屯，改建住屋，俾便禦寒；

translations.literal: Bo Qitu memorialized requesting fewer households with more land per household, permission to buy servants to farm in their stead, concentration in the central colony, and rebuilding dwellings for easier protection against cold;
translations.idiomatic: Bo Qitu asked to reduce households while increasing land per household, allow purchase of servants to farm in their stead, concentrate settlers in the central colony, and rebuild dwellings for better protection against the cold;

sentences.zh: 雖得請，尋召授工部尚書兼領侍衛內大臣，繼任者不果行其議，故移駐卒未如額。

translations.literal: though permission was granted, he was soon summoned as Minister of Works with concurrent Chief Guard of the Inner Palace; his successor did not carry out the proposal, and resettlement never reached the quota.
translations.idiomatic: though permission was granted, he was soon recalled as Minister of Works with concurrent Chief Guard of the Inner Palace; his successor did not carry out the proposal, and resettlement never reached the quota.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒，贈太子太保，諡敬僖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died; he was posthumously granted Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous title Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died; he was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：保寧、松筠、富俊並出自籓族，久膺邊寄，晉綸扉，稱名相，伊犁、吉林屯田，利在百世；

translations.literal: The commentator says: Bao Ning, Song Yun, and Fu Jun all came from frontier clans, long held frontier appointments, rose to the privy council, and were famed as chief ministers; military colonization at Ili and Jilin benefits a hundred generations;
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Bao Ning, Song Yun, and Fu Jun all came from frontier clans, long held frontier appointments, rose to the privy council, and were famed as chief ministers; military colonization at Ili and Jilin benefits generations to come;

sentences.zh: 然限於事勢，收效未盡如所規畫，甚矣締造之艱也！

translations.literal: yet constrained by circumstances, results did not fully match what was planned—how arduous was the founding of the dynasty!
translations.idiomatic: yet constrained by circumstances, results did not fully match what was planned—how arduous was the founding of the dynasty!

sentences.zh: 松筠在吉林，請開小綏芬屯墾，當時以不急之務沮之；

translations.literal: Song Yun at Jilin requested opening colonization at Xiaosuifen; at the time it was blocked as a non-urgent matter;
translations.idiomatic: Song Yun at Jilin asked to open colonization at Xiaosuifen; at the time it was blocked as a non-urgent matter;

sentences.zh: 至咸、同間，其地竟劃歸俄界。

translations.literal: by the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns that land was finally assigned to Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: by the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns that land had been assigned to Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 苟早經營，奚致輕棄？

translations.literal: Had it been developed early, how could it have been lightly abandoned?
translations.idiomatic: Had it been developed early, how could it have been lightly abandoned?

sentences.zh: 實邊之計，顧可忽哉！

translations.literal: Plans to solidify the frontier—how can they be neglected!
translations.idiomatic: Plans to solidify the frontier—how can they be neglected!
